author: A moon-priest of Torval

#The Two Moons

Outsiders call them Masser and Secunda. We call them Jone and Jode, and we say they are the eyes of the moons' dance, Lunar Lattice, which holds all Khajiit together.

The phase of the moons at a cub's birth decides what shape that cub will grow into: small or great, nimble or strong.

#The Mane

When both moons are dark at once, a cub may be born who is the Mane: one Khajiit who speaks for all. The Mane's fur is braided by the clans, and every braid is a promise.

There is only ever one Mane. When a Mane dies, Elsweyr waits, and watches the sky.
